summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.0-rc0): ## What's Changed **Models run on MLX on Apple Silicon by default** In this release, on Apple Silicon devices, model architectures supported by the MLX runtime will automatically run on MLX. ``` ollama pull qwen3.8 ollama run qwen3.8 ``` During the pre-release we will be testing and enabling additional models. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.34.4...v0.40.0-rc0
